title_en: PAMF: Compact RF Fingerprinting for Spaceborne Passive Sensing under Receiver and Channel Shifts
title_zh: PAMF：面向天基被动感知的紧凑跨接收机射频指纹识别
abstract_en: Spaceborne passive RF fingerprinting seeks to identify physical terrestrial transmitters from their emissions, despite changes in receiving hardware and propagation, within a limited payload-processing budget. We present PAMF, a compact source-only RF fingerprint identifier designed for this joint requirement. Its structured representation combines temporal/spectral processing, nonlinear-memory features, reference-relative responses, and three projected local SIG-TIME descriptors. Receiver-aware Tri-SIG-TIME SSL exploits partially labeled source recordings through cross-receiver pairing, feature perturbation, and labeled-gradient anchoring; inference requires no target adaptation or additional classification head. On the six-class Main split of WiSig with six simulated space--ground channel conditions, three-seed mean direct accuracies are 71.16% for unseen receivers and 68.81% for joint receiver/date holdout, exceeding the strongest evaluated external comparator by 5.86 and 5.22 percentage points. An optional independently trained DURA front end raises these means to 79.90% and 76.83%. PAMF contains 232,993 parameters, 93.94% fewer than the compared ResNet-18-1D, and requires 0.89 MiB for FP32 weights. Receiver re-partitioning, label-budget studies, and two-layer ablations examine the conditions supporting these gains. The resulting accuracy and parameter-storage trade-off motivates payload-oriented inference; real in-orbit performance and hardware-specific latency remain to be validated.
abstract_zh: 天基被动射频指纹识别需要在有限载荷处理预算下，克服接收硬件与传播变化，从地面辐射信号中识别具体物理发射机。本文针对这一联合需求，提出仅利用源域训练的紧凑射频指纹识别器 PAMF。其结构化表征融合时频处理、非线性记忆特征、相对参考响应和三个投影空间中的局部 SIG-TIME 描述。接收机感知的 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 通过跨接收机配对、特征扰动和有标签梯度锚定利用部分标注的源记录；推理不需要目标域适应或额外分类头。在 WiSig 六类 Main split 及六种模拟星地信道条件下，三种子直接识别平均准确率在未见接收机与接收机／日期双留出中分别为 71.16% 和 68.81%，比所评估的最强外部对照分别高 5.86 和 5.22 个百分点。接入独立训练的可选 DURA 前端后，两者提高至 79.90% 和 76.83%。PAMF 包含 232993 个参数，比所比较的 ResNet-18-1D 少 93.94%，FP32 权重仅占 0.89 MiB。接收机重划分、标签预算研究及两层消融进一步检验这些收益成立的条件。准确率与参数存储的折中支持面向载荷推理的设计；真实在轨性能及特定硬件时延仍需验证。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 引言

blocks.en: For a spaceborne passive RF fingerprinting payload, successful identification requires more than recognizing signals collected by the training receiver. A useful model must retain transmitter identity when receiving hardware and propagation conditions change, and its inference footprint must fit the available processing resources. Space-based RF sensing supports wide-area spectrum monitoring, interference assessment, and emitter characterization; a recent survey relates these applications to both geolocation and device fingerprinting \cite{space_review}. An industry summary of Scott's cover story describes the transition of commercial satellite RF services toward operational use \cite{scott_digest}. This development makes a joint question central: how can a small identifier preserve useful transmitter distinctions across unseen receivers and impaired space--ground observations?
blocks.zh: 对于天基被动射频指纹识别载荷，识别成功不能仅以训练接收机采集的信号为依据。有效模型需要在接收硬件与传播条件改变时保留发射机身份判别能力，同时使推理开销适应可用处理资源。天基 RF 感知能够支持广域频谱监测、干扰评估与辐射源特征分析；近期综述将这些应用与地理定位和设备指纹识别联系起来\cite{space_review}。Scott 封面报道的产业摘要也介绍了商业卫星 RF 服务走向实际应用的过程\cite{scott_digest}。由此引出本文的核心问题：如何用一个小型识别器，在未见接收机与受损星地观测中保持有用的发射机个体差异？

blocks.en: Recent deployments illustrate this development. On October 20, 2026, HawkEye 360 announced the successful launch of its three-satellite Cluster 15, whose antenna architecture supports simultaneous RF collection and mission-data downlink \cite{hawkeye15}. In China, the Diting 01 A/B/C satellites launched on September 20, 2026, were reported as a commercial formation for space-based RF data collection, spectrum monitoring, and emitter geolocation \cite{diting01}. These examples establish the relevance of satellite RF observation; they do not, by themselves, establish device-level fingerprint identification. In particular, successful signal detection or geolocation does not imply that weak transmitter-dependent differences remain distinguishable after propagation and reception.
blocks.zh: 近期部署体现了这一发展趋势。2026 年 10 月 20 日，HawkEye 360 宣布其三星编队 Cluster 15 成功发射，其天线架构支持 RF 采集与任务数据下传同步进行\cite{hawkeye15}。在中国，2026 年 9 月 20 日发射的谛听 01 组 A/B/C 星被报道用于商业天基 RF 数据采集、频谱监测与辐射源地理定位\cite{diting01}。这些案例说明了卫星 RF 观测的应用价值，但其本身并不构成设备级指纹识别的验证。尤其是，成功检测信号或确定辐射源位置，并不意味着微弱的发射机个体差异在传播与接收后仍然可分。

blocks.en: The deployment architecture is also evolving. Peng Cheng Laboratory's PEGA-SUS1, launched on September 20, 2026, integrates non-terrestrial-network components, onboard AI computing, and space--ground communication payloads in an in-orbit verification platform \cite{pegasus1}. Such platforms motivate models with small weight storage and manageable inference operations. They also make deployment requirements concrete: receiver changes should not require collecting a newly labeled target dataset or refitting a separate head. We study ground-side learning from partially labeled source receivers followed by frozen inference at an unseen receiver. The design targets deployable recognition without making target-domain access a prerequisite.
blocks.zh: 系统部署方式也在演进。鹏城实验室于 2026 年 9 月 20 日发射的 PEGA-SUS1 将非地面网络组件、星载 AI 计算与星地通信载荷集成于在轨验证平台\cite{pegasus1}。这类平台为权重存储小、推理运算可控的模型提供了应用动机，也使部署需求更加具体：更换接收机不应以重新收集目标域标注数据或单独拟合分类头为前提。本文研究利用部分标注的地面源接收机数据学习，再在未见接收机上冻结推理的方式，面向无需将目标域访问作为前提的可部署识别。

blocks.en: RF fingerprint identification (RFFI) associates received waveform characteristics with transmitter hardware. Device-dependent oscillator behavior, modulation imperfections, and nonlinear responses can provide identity evidence even when devices share a protocol and nominal hardware design. Engineered-feature methods describe selected signal properties, whereas deep models learn discriminative representations from signal observations \cite{rffi_survey}. The relevant objective here is closed-set identification among enrolled transmitters, rather than waveform-type classification, geolocation, or unrestricted discovery of unknown devices. In passive reception, explicit identity fields may be absent or unsuitable as the recognition basis, making the persistence of hardware-related evidence across acquisition environments central to the task.
blocks.zh: 射频指纹识别（RFFI）将接收波形特征与发射机硬件联系起来。即使设备使用相同协议和标称硬件设计，其振荡器行为、调制缺陷与非线性响应仍可能提供身份依据。人工特征方法描述预先选定的信号性质，深度模型则从观测信号中学习判别表征\cite{rffi_survey}。本文研究的是已注册发射机之间的闭集身份识别，而非信号类型分类、地理定位或不受限制的未知设备发现。在被动接收中，显式身份字段可能缺失，或不适合作为识别依据，因此硬件相关信息能否跨采集环境保持可辨识性，是该任务的核心。

blocks.en: The received fingerprint is not a transmitter-only observation. Propagation filters the transmitted waveform, while receiver frequency response, synchronization, and front-end imperfections further modify it. A classifier can consequently exploit acquisition-specific correlations that predict identity in the source data but do not persist at deployment. WiSig provides measured WiFi recordings across receivers and recording dates, enabling these effects to be examined beyond a single acquisition configuration \cite{wisig}. Holding out receivers tests sensitivity to receiving hardware and associated acquisition conditions; additionally holding out a recording date introduces another distribution change. Accuracy under a random within-environment split cannot substitute for either test.
blocks.zh: 接收到的指纹并非仅由发射机决定。传播过程对发射波形进行滤波，接收机频率响应、同步误差与前端缺陷又会进一步改变波形。因此，分类器可能利用源数据中与身份相关、但部署后不再成立的采集条件。WiSig 提供跨接收机和采集日期的实测 WiFi 记录，使这类影响能够在单一采集配置之外得到检验\cite{wisig}。留出接收机用于检验模型对接收硬件及相关采集条件的敏感性，进一步留出采集日期则引入另一种分布变化。同一环境内随机划分得到的准确率不能替代这两类测试。

blocks.en: Space--ground reception introduces a further robustness requirement. Geometry-dependent attenuation and Doppler, together with noise and multipath, can obscure the small waveform differences used for identity discrimination. Non-terrestrial-network studies provide a physical context for these propagation effects \cite{ntn}, but a communication-channel model alone does not establish preservation of RF fingerprints. The practical question is whether useful identity evidence remains after impairment and whether compensation improves identification without removing that evidence. We investigate this question using measured terrestrial IQ with controlled, geometry-informed synthetic impairments. This experimental proxy supports reproducible robustness analysis, while remaining distinct from validation using real satellite RF recordings.
blocks.zh: 星地接收还带来了额外的稳健性要求。与几何关系相关的衰减和多普勒效应，以及噪声与多径，可能掩盖身份判别所依赖的细微波形差异。非地面网络研究为这些传播效应提供了物理背景\cite{ntn}，但通信信道模型本身不能证明射频指纹得到保留。实际需要回答的是：受损信号中是否仍存在可用的身份信息，以及补偿能否在保留该信息的同时改善识别。本文采用实测地面 IQ，并叠加受控、考虑几何因素的合成损伤研究这一问题。该实验代理能够支持可复现的稳健性分析，但与真实卫星 RF 记录验证具有明确区别。

blocks.en: Domain adaptation and domain generalization address distribution changes under different information assumptions. For example, transfer learning for satellite ADS-B identification has combined learned features with source--target discrepancy reduction \cite{transfer_sat}; receiver-impact mitigation has also been studied through domain adaptation \cite{receiver_da}. These approaches are relevant when the required target data are accessible. By contrast, domain generalization learns from source domains alone and evaluates transfer to an unseen target \cite{dg_survey}. Our source-only setting follows the latter assumption: neither target IQ nor target labels participate in training, checkpoint selection, or adaptation. Unlabeled source data must therefore provide additional learning information without being confused with unlabeled target-domain access.
blocks.zh: 域适应与域泛化在不同的信息可用条件下处理分布变化。例如，卫星 ADS-B 个体识别研究将学习特征与源域、目标域差异缩减相结合\cite{transfer_sat}，也有研究通过域适应缓解接收机影响\cite{receiver_da}。在所需目标数据可获取时，这些方法具有应用价值。相比之下，域泛化仅利用源域学习，再检验模型向未见目标域的迁移能力\cite{dg_survey}。本文仅源域设置遵循后一假设：目标 IQ 和目标标签均不参与训练、检查点选择或适应。因此，模型需要从无标签源数据中获得额外学习信息，同时明确区分无标签源域使用与无标签目标域访问。

blocks.en: Recent RFFI studies have made receiver and channel dependence an explicit learning objective. RIEI investigates transmitter- and receiver-related representation separation for cross-receiver generalization \cite{riei}. DRIFT combines feature disentanglement with adversarial training \cite{drift}, and an information-bottleneck approach studies the suppression of redundant receiver-related information \cite{ib}. Single-source domain generalization addresses channel shortcuts through domain expansion and alignment \cite{sdg}. Together, these studies establish strong motivations for acquisition-robust learning. The question pursued here is complementary: how should a compact waveform representation preserve useful identity relationships while its training procedure introduces receiver variation under limited identity supervision?
blocks.zh: 近期 RFFI 研究已将接收机与信道依赖作为明确的学习目标。RIEI 通过发射机相关与接收机相关表征的分离研究跨接收机泛化\cite{riei}。DRIFT 将特征解耦与对抗训练结合\cite{drift}，信息瓶颈方法则研究冗余接收机相关信息的抑制\cite{ib}。单源域泛化通过域扩展与对齐处理信道捷径\cite{sdg}。这些工作为学习对采集条件稳健的表征提供了充分动机。本文进一步关注一个互补问题：在身份监督有限、训练过程又需要引入接收机变化时，紧凑的波形表征应如何保留有用的身份关系？

blocks.en: A compact representation should preserve complementary identity relationships instead of relying on capacity alone. Local temporal and spectral patterns, amplitude-dependent nonlinear memory, and responses relative to an internal reference need not react identically to receiver and channel changes. Memory-polynomial models describe nonlinear RF behavior \cite{mp}, while path-signature methods summarize ordered increments and sequence interactions \cite{sig}. We use these ideas as complementary inductive biases within a shared identifier. Their role is to retain discriminative structure with a small parameter budget; branch names do not imply a unique physical decomposition. Matched architecture and deletion controls are therefore needed to distinguish a useful combination from redundant complexity.
blocks.zh: 紧凑表征应通过保留互补身份关系提高泛化能力，而非单纯依赖网络容量。局部时频模式、幅度相关的非线性记忆，以及相对于内部参考的响应，对接收机与信道变化的反应未必相同。记忆多项式描述非线性 RF 行为\cite{mp}，路径签名方法汇总有序增量与序列相互作用\cite{sig}。本文将这些思想作为共享识别器中的互补归纳偏置，目标是在较小参数预算下保留判别结构；分支名称不意味着对物理组成的唯一分解。因此，需要匹配的架构与删除对照，区分有效组合和冗余复杂度。

blocks.en: Limited identity annotations make the generalization problem more demanding. Source receivers can acquire many recordings, yet establishing transmitter identities for all recordings may be costly. Semi-supervised learning uses a labeled subset together with unlabeled observations, and confidence-based pseudo-labeling offers a simple baseline. FixMatch demonstrates how confidence filtering and consistency training can exploit unlabeled data \cite{fixmatch}. Semi-supervised domain generalization further requires the resulting model to transfer beyond the source domains: StyleMatch combines partially labeled multi-source learning with stochastic modeling and style-based multi-view consistency \cite{stylematch}. These findings motivate the use of unlabeled source recordings, but their successful use still depends on how domain variation and identity preservation are coupled.
blocks.zh: 身份标注有限会进一步增加泛化难度。源接收机可以采集大量记录，但逐条确认发射机身份可能需要较高成本。半监督学习联合使用部分有标签数据与无标签观测，其中基于置信度的伪标签是一种简洁基线。FixMatch 展示了置信度筛选与一致性训练利用无标签数据的能力\cite{fixmatch}。半监督域泛化还要求所得模型能够迁移到源域之外：StyleMatch 将部分标注的多源学习与随机建模、基于风格的多视图一致性结合\cite{stylematch}。这些结果支持利用无标签源记录，但能否有效利用，仍取决于如何将域变化与身份保持结合起来。

blocks.en: For cross-receiver RFFI, a high-confidence pseudo-label is an estimated identity, not proof of receiver-independent evidence. Pairing unrelated emitters can alter the class structure, whereas pairing only within one receiver can leave acquisition dependence insufficiently challenged. Moreover, a useful feature perturbation can produce a parameter update that conflicts with the limited true-label supervision. These considerations motivate three coupled choices in our design: select accepted same-pseudo-identity samples from different source receivers, perturb their feature statistics in a controlled manner, and anchor the resulting updates to labeled gradients. The pairing rule reduces an identifiable source of class mixing; it cannot guarantee correct identities when the pseudo-labels themselves are wrong.
blocks.zh: 在跨接收机 RFFI 中，高置信度伪标签只是身份估计，并不能证明模型使用了与接收机无关的信息。将无关发射机配对可能改变类别结构，而仅在同一接收机内配对，又可能不足以挑战采集依赖。此外，即使特征扰动具有合理动机，其产生的参数更新仍可能与有限真实标签给出的监督方向冲突。基于这些考虑，本文将三个选择结合起来：在不同源接收机之间选择通过筛选、伪身份相同的样本，对其特征统计实施受控扰动，并用有标签梯度约束所得更新。该配对规则能够减少一类明确的类别混合来源，但当伪标签本身错误时，不能保证真实身份一致。

blocks.en: PAMF addresses this requirement with a structured three-view SIG-TIME identifier. A shared temporal/spectral backbone is complemented by a power-amplifier-inspired nonlinear-memory branch and reference-relative response processing. Three learned projections encode local first-order increments and second-order antisymmetric areas, preserving relational information beyond pooled feature magnitudes. A fixed local permutation changes feature-path traversal before time-coordinate augmentation; raw IQ and backbone temporal order remain intact. These are internal feature views, not three independent RF recordings. With the original jointly trained classification head, the six-class identifier contains 232,993 parameters and occupies 0.89 MiB in FP32 weights, allowing its generalization performance to be assessed alongside a concrete deployment cost.
blocks.zh: PAMF 采用结构化三视图 SIG-TIME 识别器处理这一需求。在共享时频骨干之外，网络引入受功率放大器行为启发的非线性记忆分支与相对参考响应处理。三个可学习投影编码局部一阶增量和二阶反对称面积，保留池化特征幅值之外的关系信息。固定局部排列在加入时间坐标之前改变特征路径遍历，原始 IQ 与骨干处理的时间顺序保持原状。这些是内部特征视图，而非三份独立 RF 记录。使用原有联合训练分类头时，六类识别器包含 232993 个参数，FP32 权重占 0.89 MiB，使泛化性能能够与明确的部署成本共同评估。

blocks.en: Tri-SIG-TIME SSL builds on confidence-based source pseudo-labeling and adds receiver-aware statistical mixing, contrastive learning, and feature extrapolation. Accepted pseudo-identities provide cross-receiver pairing information, while true-label gradients guide a one-sided projection and norm constraint on the unlabeled update. The method uses current-student predictions rather than an exponential-moving-average teacher and introduces no separately fitted deployment head. This formulation links the construction of domain variation to the direction and scale of its training effect. We compare it with both the matched supervised recipe and ordinary pseudo-labeling at a confidence threshold of 0.95, and examine its constituent mechanisms under fixed training budgets.
blocks.zh: Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 以源域置信度伪标签为基础，加入接收机感知的统计混合、对比学习与特征外推。通过筛选的伪身份为跨接收机配对提供依据，真实标签梯度则指导对无标签更新进行单侧投影与范数约束。该方法使用当前学生模型预测，不使用指数滑动平均教师，也不引入单独拟合的部署分类头。由此，域变化的构造方式与其训练更新的方向和尺度联系起来。本文将其与匹配的监督配方、置信度阈值为 0.95 的普通伪标签进行比较，并在固定训练预算下检验各组成机制。

blocks.en: For severe channel impairment, PAMF also supports an optional DURA restoration front end. Learned priors combined with explicit data consistency are an established model-based reconstruction strategy \cite{modl}. DURA adapts this design principle to source-IQ restoration using a compact two-stage unfolded network, trained independently without transmitter-identity labels or access to a trained identifier. Direct PAMF and PAMF+DURA are evaluated separately. This distinction exposes the identifier's intrinsic generalization and the additional benefit of impairment compensation, while offering two deployment configurations with different processing budgets.
blocks.zh: 针对严重信道损伤，PAMF 还支持可选的 DURA 恢复前端。将学习先验与显式数据一致性结合，是成熟的基于模型重建思路\cite{modl}。DURA 将这一设计原则用于源 IQ 恢复，采用紧凑的双阶段展开网络独立训练，不使用发射机身份标签，也不访问训练好的识别器。本文分别评价直接 PAMF 与 PAMF+DURA，从而区分识别器自身的泛化能力与损伤补偿带来的额外收益，并提供处理预算不同的两种部署配置。

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are summarized as follows.
blocks.zh: 本文的主要贡献如下。

blocks.en: 1) We design a compact structured RF fingerprint identifier for receiver and channel generalization. Complementary temporal/spectral, nonlinear-memory, reference-relative, and three-view local path features are fused into one jointly trained representation. The 232,993-parameter identifier uses 93.94% fewer parameters than the compared ResNet-18-1D; pure cross-entropy architecture comparisons separate the representation's behavior from semi-supervised training.
blocks.zh: 1）设计面向接收机与信道泛化的紧凑结构化 RF 指纹识别器，将互补的时频、非线性记忆、相对参考响应和三视图局部路径特征融合于共同训练的表征中。识别器仅包含 232993 个参数，比所比较的 ResNet-18-1D 少 93.94%；纯交叉熵架构比较用于区分表征本身的表现与半监督训练的作用。

blocks.en: 2) We develop Tri-SIG-TIME SSL for source-only cross-receiver learning with limited identity labels. Same-pseudo-identity cross-receiver pairing connects feature perturbation and contrastive learning, while labeled-gradient anchoring controls the unlabeled update. Supervised, ordinary-pseudo-label, and mechanism controls test the resulting recipe and identify conditions in which its additional complexity is beneficial.
blocks.zh: 2）提出面向身份标签有限、仅源域跨接收机学习的 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL。通过同伪身份跨接收机配对连接特征扰动与对比学习，并以有标签梯度约束无标签更新。利用监督、普通伪标签及机制对照检验完整配方，明确增加训练复杂度能够带来收益的具体条件。

blocks.en: 3) We evaluate the accuracy--resource trade-off under six simulated space--ground channel conditions, receiver/date holdouts, receiver re-partitioning, label budgets, source-receiver counts, and a larger transmitter set. Eight-seed architecture/view controls complement three-seed main comparisons and two-layer ablations. Frozen, independently trained DURA provides an optional robustness extension with explicit data-use controls. The evaluation identifies both the generalization advantage and its limits, supporting payload-oriented model design on measured terrestrial IQ with simulated propagation.
blocks.zh: 3）在六种模拟星地信道条件下，通过接收机／日期留出、接收机重划分、标签预算、源接收机数量与扩展发射机集合，评估准确率与资源开销的折中。八种子架构／视图对照补充三种子主比较及两层消融；独立训练并冻结的 DURA 在明确数据权限下提供可选稳健性扩展。实验识别泛化优势及其边界，为基于实测地面 IQ 和模拟传播的载荷导向模型设计提供依据。

Section VI reports comparative results, ablations, and limitations. Section VII concludes the paper.

blocks.en: The stress model combines geometry, environment-dependent blockage, composite fading, multipath, and imperfect receive processing. NTN channel studies motivate inclusion of geometry and Doppler \cite{ntn}, but the implemented engineering parameters are not claimed to reproduce a calibrated standardized or in-orbit channel. For Earth radius R_E, altitude H, elevation angle theta, carrier f_c, and light speed c,
blocks.zh: 压力模型结合几何、环境相关遮挡、复合衰落、多径和不完美接收处理。NTN 信道研究为纳入几何和多普勒提供依据\cite{ntn}，本文工程参数不被解释为经过标定的标准信道或在轨信道。设地球半径为 R_E、轨道高度为 H、仰角为 theta、载频为 f_c、光速为 c，则

blocks.tex: \begin{align}d(\theta,H)&=\sqrt{(R_E+H)^2-R_E^2\cos^2\theta}-R_E\sin\theta,\\ L_{\rm FS}(d,f_c)&=20\log_{10}(4\pi d f_c/c),\\ g_{\rm FS}&=10^{-[L_{\rm FS}(d,f_c)-L_{\rm FS}(d_{\rm ref},f_c)]/20}\nonumber\\ &=d_{\rm ref}/d.\label{eq:fspl}\end{align}

blocks.en: We use H=600 km, f_c=2.462 GHz, R_E=6371 km, and a 60-degree reference elevation. The reference distance is approximately 683.2 km and absolute free-space loss is approximately 157.0 dB. blocks.en: For normalized measured input x, the additional propagation and receiver chain is expressed as

Statewise direct-path amplitude dB mean/SD are 0/1 for LOS and -8/3 for partial blockage; blocked observations have no direct path. Total diffuse powers are -18/-18/-20 dB and RMS delay spreads are 20/50/100 ns. Three diffuse taps are used. Within a window, the fixed zero-based permutation pi=[0,5,3,6,2,1,4,7] reorders only the signature input features, after which a monotone encoding coordinate is appended. Neither raw IQ nor the temporal backbone is permuted. For a seven-dimensional window path,

Four windows and three projections produce 336 values, followed by a 336-to-160 projection. These are low-order path descriptors \cite{sig}, not the full second-level signature tensor. No invariance to arbitrary permutations is claimed.

blocks.en: The labeled objective retains true-label CE, ordinary/raw paired KL, and shallow/intermediate same-identity cross-receiver contrast. Channel-augmented labeled slots use CE without their independent KL. Label smoothing is 0.01. The current student in evaluation mode generates stop-gradient hard pseudo-labels on raw U inputs, with no EMA teacher:
blocks.zh: 有标签目标保留真实标签 CE、普通／原始视图配对 KL，以及浅中层同身份跨接收机对比。带信道增强的有标签槽只使用 CE，不计算其独立 KL。标签平滑为 0.01。当前学生在评估模式下对原始 U 输入生成停止梯度的硬伪标签，不使用 EMA 教师：

blocks.tex: \begin{align}q_i&=\operatorname{sg}(p_\theta^{\rm eval}(X_i)),\quad\hat y_i=\arg\max_c q_{i,c},\\ m_i&=\mathbb I(\max_cq_{i,c}\ge0.95),\\ \mathcal P_i^U&=\{j:m_i=m_j=1,\hat y_i=\hat y_j,r_i\ne r_j\}.\end{align}

blocks.en: Accepted pairs guide feature-statistic mixing in shallow and intermediate layers, following the statistical-mixing construction of \cite{mixstyle}. With a stop-gradient Beta(0.1,0.1) mixing coefficient, partner means and standard deviations are mixed while normalized feature content is retained. Each layer activates with probability 0.5. Fused-feature contrast has weight 0.05. For a valid partner j, extrapolation uses the original deployment head:
blocks.zh: 接受配对指导浅层与中层统计混合，沿用\cite{mixstyle}的统计构造。混合系数为停止梯度的 Beta(0.1,0.1) 随机变量，在保留归一化特征内容的同时混合伙伴的均值和标准差。每层启用概率为 0.5，融合特征对比权重为 0.05。对于合法伙伴 j，外推通过原部署分类头约束：

blocks.en: The difference direction can also contain sample-specific variation; it is not an identified pure receiver factor. If no valid partner exists, ordinary accepted pseudo-label supervision is retained. Complete U learning uses six student forwards with shared pairing/mixing, ordinary/raw paired KL, and shallow/intermediate contrast. U's auxiliary raw slot has no additional channel augmentation. The base CE coefficients 0.5/0.25/0.25/0.25 are normalized by 1.25; extrapolation reallocates ordinary-view CE rather than adding unmatched label dose. The full U objective has weight 6. All accepted-mask CE means use the actual U batch size, not only the accepted count.
blocks.zh: 差分方向也可能包含样本自身变化，不能视为准确辨识的纯接收机因素。不存在合法伙伴时，仍保留普通接受伪标签监督。完整 U 学习采用六次学生前向，共享配对与混合方案，保留普通／原始配对 KL 和浅中层对比。U 的辅助原始槽不新增信道增强。基础 CE 系数 0.5/0.25/0.25/0.25 以 1.25 归一化；外推从普通视图 CE 重新分配剂量，不额外增加不匹配标签剂量。完整 U 目标权重为 6。接受掩码 CE 按实际 U 批量求均值，不只按接受数求均值。

blocks.en: Labeled-Gradient Anchoring and Schedule
blocks.zh: 有标签梯度锚定与训练日程

blocks.en: For each of the intermediate module, classification head, and remaining parameters, let g_L be the gradient of the complete labeled objective and g_U that of the weighted U objective. Conflicting components are removed and the remaining U norm is capped by the labeled norm:
blocks.zh: 对于中层模块、分类头及其余参数三组，令 g_L 为完整有标签目标梯度，g_U 为加权 U 目标梯度。移除冲突分量后，将 U 范数限制在有标签范数内：

blocks.tex: \begin{align}\bar g_U&=g_U-\frac{\min(\langle g_U,g_L\rangle,0)}{\|g_L\|^2}g_L,\\ \tilde g_U&=\min(1,\|g_L\|/\|\bar g_U\|)\bar g_U,\\ g&=g_L+\tilde g_U.\label{eq:guard}\end{align}

blocks.en: When the labeled squared norm is at most 10^(-12), that group's U contribution is zero; a zero projected U gradient is left zero. This guarantees the declared gradient alignment, not monotonic loss reduction after a finite Adam step. Training is E50 with labeled/U batches 128/256: epochs 1--13 use L only, 14--20 add ordinary PL, and 21--50 enable complete U learning and protection. All later 37 epochs jointly use L and U. Feature mixing, extrapolation, contrast losses, and gradient anchoring are training-only operations.
blocks.zh: 有标签梯度平方范数不超过 10^(-12) 时，该组 U 贡献置零；投影后 U 梯度为零时保持零。该规则约束所声明的梯度方向，不保证有限 Adam 步之后损失单调下降。训练为 E50，L/U 批量为 128/256：第 1 至 13 轮仅 L，第 14 至 20 轮加入普通 PL，第 21 至 50 轮启用完整 U 学习与保护。后 37 轮均联合使用 L 与 U。统计混合、外推、对比损失及梯度锚定仅用于训练。

blocks.en: Independent Source-Only Restoration
blocks.zh: 独立的源域恢复前端

blocks.en: DURA is an optional dual-stage unrolled restoration architecture. A coarse estimator yields c from the current received window y. An action estimator predicts a 64-tap FIR, pointwise main/image coefficients, and one positive scalar variance v. It defines a real-linear operator, with the adjoint taken under the real part of the complex inner product:
blocks.zh: DURA 是可选的双阶段展开恢复结构。粗恢复模块由当前接收窗口 y 产生 c，作用估计器预测 64 抽头 FIR、逐点主／镜像系数和一个正标量方差 v，构成实线性算子，其伴随对应复内积的实部：

blocks.en: Starting from x_0=c, stage k uses a learned prior informed by the backprojected observation residual and approximately solves a soft consistency problem:
blocks.zh: 从 x_0=c 开始，第 k 阶段根据观测残差的反投影构造学习先验，并近似求解软一致性问题：

blocks.en: Each stage performs two CG iterations, for four iterations in total. The six-class identifier and DURA contain 232,993 and 266,951 parameters, respectively. Source IQ is paired with its simulated distortion for G training; TX labels, trained classifier outputs, and target samples do not train G. The compact student also uses frozen source-trained restoration ancestry, whose cost is separate from incremental student training. For each experimental setting, G's training contract is matched to source receivers and physical roles. G-L and G-LU use L IQ and L+U IQ, respectively, without their TX labels. One fixed G is normally shared across identifier seeds. Restoration predicts a useful waveform estimate; it does not certify exact recovery of intrinsic transmitter parameters.
blocks.zh: 每阶段执行两次 CG，共四次。六类识别器与 DURA 分别包含 232993 和 266951 个参数。G 使用源 IQ 及其模拟失真配对训练，不读取 TX 标签、训练好分类器输出或目标样本。紧凑学生还利用冻结的源域恢复教师祖先，其成本与学生新增训练成本分开。各实验 G 的训练契约与源接收机和物理角色匹配。G-L 与 G-LU 分别使用 L IQ 和 L+U IQ，均不读取其 TX 标签。多个识别器种子通常共享一个固定 G。恢复输出是有用的波形估计，不证明精确恢复固有发射机参数。

blocks.en: Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 实验设置

blocks.en: Table~\ref{tab:settings} specifies the main data roles. Cross-RX testing uses unseen receivers on source dates D1--D3; double holdout additionally uses D0. D0 precedes the training dates, so double holdout is not future-date extrapolation. Cross-date results at source receivers are retained as supplementary diagnostics. Main-split receiver/date populations are reported separately rather than hidden by their 3:1 packet-weighted pool.
blocks.zh: Table~\ref{tab:settings} 列出主要数据角色。跨接收机使用未见 RX 的源日期 D1 至 D3；双跨还使用 D0。D0 早于训练日期，因此双跨不等于未来日期外推。源接收机上的跨日结果保留为补充诊断。Main split 的跨接收机与双跨分别报告，不以包数比为 3:1 的综合池掩盖两者差异。

blocks.en: There are three receiver splits, label fractions 1/5/10%, source counts 1--6, and a ten-class setting with 16 source and 16 target receivers. Source-count curves use the same six target receivers [0,2,5,7,9,10]; the five-source point is reconstructed from existing Main-split stratified confusion matrices. Source count changes available sample size as well as receiver diversity. Six-scene means equally average the six practical accuracies within each model seed before averaging over seeds. Repeated channel views of one IQ are correlated derivatives, not new physical observations.
blocks.zh: 实验覆盖三种 RX 划分、1/5/10% 标签、1 至 6 个源接收机，以及 16 源／16 目标 RX 的十类设置。源数量曲线统一目标 RX=[0,2,5,7,9,10]，五源点由已有 Main split 分层混淆矩阵重建。源数量同时改变样本量与接收机多样性。六景平均先在每个模型种子内等权平均六个 practical 准确率，再跨种子汇总。同一 IQ 的多个信道视图是相关派生数据，不是新增物理观测。

blocks.en: Architecture controls use E200 CE, no U and no ordinary/channel augmentation, with eight seeds. E50 structural CE controls retain their registered true-label augmentation slots, with no KL, contrast, or U. PAMF-Sup retains complete labeled objectives; PAMF-PL adds ordinary PL at threshold 0.95 and weight 1 with natural local order. Complete PAMF uses fixed local permutation and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL. Main comparisons generally use three identifier seeds; a separate direct-inference single/three-view panel has eight paired seeds. External Full objectives are augmented with the registered channel CE and ordinary PL; native budgets are E100 for RIEI/DRIFT and E200 for IB-RFF/SDG, versus PAMF E50. Epoch counts alone are not compute-matched.
blocks.zh: 架构控制使用 E200 纯 CE，无 U、无普通／信道增强，采用八种子。E50 结构 CE 控制保留预登记的真实标签增强槽，不含 KL、对比或 U。PAMF-Sup 保留完整有标签目标；PAMF-PL 在自然局部顺序下加入阈值 0.95、权重 1 的普通 PL。完整 PAMF 使用固定局部排列与 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL。主比较通常为三个识别器种子；独立单／三视图直接识别面板具有八个配对种子。外部 Full 目标加入已登记的信道 CE 与普通 PL；RIEI/DRIFT 原生预算为 E100，IB-RFF/SDG 为 E200，PAMF 为 E50。轮数本身不等于计算量匹配。

blocks.en: All predictions are frozen before independent truth-side scoring. Accuracy and macro-F1 use the same rows and physical populations. Error bars are sample SD across model seeds, not confidence intervals. Shared restoration weights mean restored-result SD does not quantify joint F/G retraining uncertainty. The benchmark has been used during method development; the results are not described as a newly untouched blind confirmation.
blocks.zh: 全部预测固定后才独立连接真值评分。准确率与 Macro-F1 使用同一实验行和物理群体。误差棒为模型种子间样本标准差，不是置信区间。恢复权重共享意味着恢复结果标准差不刻画 F/G 联合重训不确定性。该基准曾用于方法研发，本文不将结果描述为新建立且从未接触的盲测确认。

blocks.en: Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 结果与讨论

blocks.en: Generalization Beyond the Training Receiver
blocks.zh: 超出训练接收机的泛化能力

blocks.en: The central result is that PAMF's advantage survives the combination of receiver mismatch and simulated space--ground impairment. Table~\ref{tab:main} shows a 5.86-percentage-point direct six-scene advantage over the strongest evaluated external comparator, SDG, on unseen receivers. The advantage remains 5.22 points when the recording date is also held out. Because these are direct identifier outputs, the difference cannot be attributed to DURA. It supports the integrated representation and training design as the primary source of the observed comparative advantage.
blocks.zh: 核心结果是：PAMF 的优势在接收机不匹配与模拟星地损伤同时存在时仍然保持。Table~\ref{tab:main} 显示，其未见接收机直接识别六景平均比已评估的最强外部对照 SDG 高 5.86 个百分点；进一步留出采集日期后，优势仍为 5.22 个百分点。这些结果来自识别器直接输出，不能归因于 DURA，而是支持完整表征与训练设计构成所观察比较优势的主要来源。

blocks.en: The date holdout tests an additional acquisition change rather than future-time forecasting: D0 precedes the source training dates. Its value is that PAMF's relative advantage persists outside the receiver/date combinations used for learning. With a setting-matched G-LU, the corresponding six-scene accuracies reach 79.90% and 76.83%, revealing further room for improvement through input restoration. We next separate architecture, training, and channel effects to determine what this overall result actually establishes.
blocks.zh: 日期留出检验的是额外采集变化，而非未来时刻预测，因为 D0 早于源训练日期。其意义在于，PAMF 的相对优势在训练未使用的接收机／日期组合上仍然存在。接入与设置匹配的 G-LU 后，两类六景准确率分别达到 79.90% 和 76.83%，说明输入恢复还能进一步改善结果。下文分别检查结构、训练与信道作用，明确这一总体结果能够支持哪些结论。

blocks.en: Discriminative Structure without a Large Backbone
blocks.zh: 不依赖大骨干的判别表征

blocks.en: The CE-only comparison asks whether the representation remains competitive when the complete SSL recipe is removed. In Fig.~\ref{fig:2}, three-view PAMF exceeds Complex ResNet-18-1D by 4.67 points on the joint holdout while using a much smaller model. This matters for deployment: the recognition advantage is not obtained simply by increasing backbone capacity. The top panel uses 126,000 target packets from D1--D3; the bottom uses the disjoint 42,000 packets from held-out D0. Their consistent strong PAMF performance links the compact structure to cross-receiver discrimination, independently of the E50 SSL recipe.
blocks.zh: 纯 CE 比较回答：去掉完整 SSL 配方后，该表征是否仍有竞争力。Fig.~\ref{fig:2} 中，三视图 PAMF 在双留出上比 Complex ResNet-18-1D 高 4.67 个百分点，同时使用更小的模型。这对部署具有直接意义：识别优势并非简单依靠增大骨干容量获得。上图采用 D1--D3 的 126000 条目标记录，下图采用互不重叠的留出日期 D0 的 42000 条记录。PAMF 在两者中的较强表现，将紧凑结构与跨接收机判别联系起来，且独立于 E50 SSL 配方。

blocks.en: The same evidence also refines the role of the three-view design. Single-view PAMF is already strong; adding two projections changes joint-holdout clean accuracy by only 0.10 points. The larger gap to the no-SIG variant supports retaining local path information, but this panel does not establish a large independent benefit from the number of views. We retain three views as the evaluated complete configuration and assess branch dependence separately under the channel-stress training conditions.
blocks.zh: 同一证据也使三视图的作用更加明确。单视图 PAMF 已具有较强表现，增加两个投影在双留出 clean 上仅改变 0.10 个百分点；相对去 SIG 变体更大的差距支持保留局部路径信息，但该面板不能证明视图数量本身带来大幅独立收益。本文将三视图保留为已评估的完整配置，并在信道压力训练条件下另行检验分支依赖。

blocks.en: CE-only architecture comparison, E200, clean, eight paired model seeds. Top: cross-receiver testing on D1--D3 (126,000 packets per seed). Bottom: receiver/date holdout on D0 (42,000 packets per seed). Both include all 15 variants. Points and error bars show mean plus/minus sample SD; gray dots show individual seeds.
blocks.zh: 纯 CE 架构比较，E200、clean、八个配对模型种子。上：D1--D3 跨接收机，每种子 126000 条；下：D0 接收机／日期双留出，每种子 42000 条。两图均包含完整 15 种变体。点与误差棒为均值及样本标准差，灰点为逐种子结果。

blocks.en: What the Training Controls Explain
blocks.zh: 训练对照解释了什么

blocks.en: Fig.~\ref{fig:3} and Table~\ref{tab:learning} locate the contribution of unlabeled-source training within the complete system. Ordinary PL already provides a strong PAMF baseline. Moving to the complete recipe improves cross-receiver clean accuracy by 2.25 points, whereas the direct six-scene change is only 0.11 points. Thus the much larger advantage over external identifiers cannot be interpreted as a gain caused solely by the new SSL components. It combines the representation, supervised learning objectives, augmentation, and unlabeled-data recipe.
blocks.zh: Fig.~\ref{fig:3} 与 Table~\ref{tab:learning} 用于定位无标签源域训练在完整系统中的作用。普通 PL 已构成较强的 PAMF 基线。采用完整配方后，跨接收机 clean 提高 2.25 个百分点，但直接六景变化仅为 0.11 个百分点。因此，相对外部识别器更大的优势不能全部解释为新 SSL 组件的收益，而是共同包含表征、监督学习目标、增强与无标签数据配方的作用。

blocks.en: Six-scene learning-regime comparison with augmentation. Top: cross-receiver; bottom: receiver/date holdout. Supervision denotes native labeled objectives rather than the E200 CE-only recipe. Restored columns retain the original F/G pairings; Table~\ref{tab:learning} separates identifier and restorer data use.
blocks.zh: 有增强六景学习方式比较，上为跨接收机，下为接收机／日期双留出。监督指原生有标签目标，不等于 E200 纯 CE 配方。恢复列保留原 F/G 配对；Table~\ref{tab:learning} 进一步区分识别器与恢复器的数据使用。

blocks.en: The controls reveal an interaction between training and readout. With the same fixed local permutation, complete SSL is below the supervised model on direct six-scene accuracy, but slightly above it after the same G-LU. Better clean discrimination therefore does not automatically imply better robustness to every waveform impairment. The full recipe and ordinary PL also differ in local ordering, so that comparison estimates the deployable recipes as a whole. Its restored cross-receiver difference is positive in seven of 11 settings and negative in four. We consequently use SSL as a tested support for generalization rather than claim that its extra components universally improve ordinary PL.
blocks.zh: 对照还揭示了训练与读出之间的交互：在固定局部排列相同的条件下，完整 SSL 的直接六景准确率低于监督模型，接入同一 G-LU 后则略高。这说明，更强的 clean 判别并不自动转化为对各类波形损伤都更稳健。完整配方与普通 PL 还同时改变局部顺序，因此二者比较估计的是可部署整体配方的差异。其恢复后跨接收机差值在 11 个设置中七正四负。本文据此将 SSL 作为经过检验的泛化支撑，而不宣称附加组件能在所有条件下改善普通 PL。

blocks.en: Channel Bottlenecks and Transfer across Data Conditions
blocks.zh: 信道瓶颈与数据条件迁移

blocks.en: The seven-condition curves in Fig.~\ref{fig:4} explain why an aggregate lead is insufficient to characterize robustness. PAMF separates clearly from the external methods in clean and moderate impairment conditions, but its direct low-urban accuracy approaches SDG: 51.99% versus 51.11% for cross-receiver testing, and approximately 50.06% for both on the joint holdout. The hardest setting therefore exposes a shared bottleneck despite differences in identifier design. This pattern is consistent with severe corruption suppressing the identity evidence available to the classifier; it does not show that a larger classifier would recover the missing evidence.
blocks.zh: Fig.~\ref{fig:4} 的七条件曲线解释了为何不能仅用平均领先描述稳健性。PAMF 在 clean 与中等损伤条件下与外部方法形成较清楚的差距，但低仰角城市场景的直接准确率接近 SDG：跨接收机为 51.99% 与 51.11%，双留出中两者均约为 50.06%。最困难设置因此揭示了不同识别器设计共同面临的瓶颈。该模式与严重损伤压制分类器可利用身份信息的解释一致，并不能说明增大分类器即可恢复这些信息。

blocks.en: Seven-condition robustness. Top: cross-receiver; bottom: receiver/date holdout. PAMF+DURA uses the same identifier as direct PAMF.
blocks.zh: 七条件稳健性。上为跨接收机，下为接收机／日期双留出。PAMF+DURA 与直接 PAMF 使用同一识别器。

blocks.en: Restoration is most useful where this bottleneck is strongest. DURA raises PAMF's low-urban accuracy by 16.58 points under receiver holdout and 17.31 points under joint holdout, while clean accuracy changes by less than 0.07 points. The benefit is therefore concentrated in impaired observations rather than a uniform shift of all predictions. This supports using the compact identifier alone when its direct performance is adequate, and adding restoration when the propagation regime justifies the extra processing. The six-scene average remains an equal-weight stress summary, not a mission-specific occurrence-weighted accuracy.
blocks.zh: 恢复在该瓶颈最明显时更有价值。DURA 使 PAMF 的低仰角城市准确率在接收机留出与双留出中分别提高 16.58 和 17.31 个百分点，而 clean 变化小于 0.07 个百分点。收益因此主要集中于受损观测，而非对所有预测产生一致偏移。这支持两种配置：直接表现已足够时使用紧凑识别器，传播条件需要时再增加恢复处理。六景平均仍是等权压力汇总，并非按具体任务发生概率加权的准确率。

blocks.en: Receiver re-partitioning probes a different failure mode. Training-set size is matched across the three five-source splits, yet restored PAMF accuracy spans 66.58% to 79.90% (Fig.~\ref{fig:5}). This sensitivity shows that receiver composition matters even when the sample budget is controlled. Increasing the labeled fraction from 1% to 10% improves the corresponding Main-split result from 74.43% to 79.90%, indicating that source supervision still constrains transfer. These findings favor collecting representative source receivers and reliable labels over treating a single favorable split as a complete deployment forecast.
blocks.zh: 接收机重划分检验另一类失效因素。三套五源划分的训练样本量相同，恢复后 PAMF 准确率仍跨越 66.58% 至 79.90%（Fig.~\ref{fig:5}）。这说明，即使控制样本预算，接收机组成仍影响迁移。Main split 的标注比例从 1% 增加至 10% 时，对应结果由 74.43% 提高至 79.90%，表明源域监督仍然约束泛化。相比将某个有利划分当作完整部署预测，这些发现更支持收集有代表性的源接收机数据与可靠标签。

blocks.en: Six-scene sensitivity to receiver partition and label fraction. Top row: receiver splits; bottom row: label fraction. Left: cross-receiver; right: receiver/date holdout. Main-split/ten-percent endpoints reuse existing models.
blocks.zh: 接收机划分与标签比例的六景敏感性。上排为接收机划分，下排为标注比例；左列为跨接收机，右列为接收机／日期双留出。Main split／10% 端点复用已有模型。

blocks.en: The source-count curves and ten-class study delimit how far the current result extends. Six-scene accuracy is nonmonotonic as source count increases (Fig.~\ref{fig:6}), whereas the accompanying clean results generally improve; receiver coverage and data volume increase together, so this is not an isolated test of receiver diversity. Expanding to ten transmitters lowers direct six-scene accuracy to 62.09%, while restoration recovers it to 72.60%. Together, the experiments support transfer across the evaluated conditions but show that neither source count nor a strong six-class result guarantees scale-independent robustness.
blocks.zh: 源数量曲线与十类研究限定了当前结果能够扩展多远。源数量增加时，六景准确率并不单调（Fig.~\ref{fig:6}），而随附的 clean 结果总体改善；接收机覆盖与数据量同步增加，因此该研究未单独隔离接收机多样性的作用。扩展至十个发射机后，直接六景准确率降至 62.09%，恢复后为 72.60%。这些实验共同支持所评估条件之间的迁移，同时表明源数量增加或六类上的较强结果，均不能保证不受规模影响的稳健性。

blocks.en: One-to-six-source six-scene curves on the common target receivers. Top: cross-receiver; bottom: receiver/date holdout. Corresponding clean curves and full values accompany the supplementary data.
blocks.zh: 共同目标接收机上的一至六源六景曲线。上为跨接收机，下为接收机／日期双留出。对应 clean 曲线与完整数值随补充数据提供。

blocks.en: Restoration as a Modular Robustness Extension
blocks.zh: 作为模块化稳健性扩展的恢复

blocks.en: Fig.~\ref{fig:7} tests whether DURA's effect is specific to PAMF. The same setting-matched frozen restorer improves the mean six-scene accuracy of all five frozen identifiers, so its utility is not restricted to retraining a particular classifier. PAMF retains the highest restored accuracy among the evaluated models, combining a strong direct representation with useful waveform compensation. Because G is trained without identity labels or classifier feedback, these gains demonstrate a modular route to robustness under the declared source-data permissions.
blocks.zh: Fig.~\ref{fig:7} 检查 DURA 的作用是否仅针对 PAMF。相同设置下的同一冻结恢复器提高了五种冻结识别器的六景平均，说明其作用并不局限于重新训练某个特定分类器。在所评估模型中，PAMF 仍保持最高恢复后准确率，将较强的直接表征与有效的波形补偿结合起来。由于 G 训练不使用身份标签或分类器反馈，这些收益展示了在已声明源数据权限下增强稳健性的一条模块化路径。

blocks.en: DURA gains for five frozen identifiers. Top: cross-receiver; bottom: receiver/date holdout. Curved arrows connect direct and restored means and show percentage-point gains. Each pair shares F and a setting-matched G.
blocks.zh: 五种冻结识别器的 DURA 收益。上为跨接收机，下为接收机／日期双留出。曲线箭头连接直接与恢复均值，标明百分点提升；每对共享 F 并使用设置匹配的 G。

blocks.en: The comparison holds F fixed before and after restoration, but shares G across the three F seeds. Its error bars consequently describe mainly identifier-seed variation and do not estimate full restorer-training uncertainty. Recognition improvement is evidence that the restored signal is more useful to these classifiers; it is not a measurement of uniquely recovered transmitter hardware. A matched comparison against alternative restorers remains necessary for a restoration-specific superiority claim.
blocks.zh: 恢复前后比较固定 F，但三个 F 种子共享 G。因此，误差棒主要描述识别器种子变化，并未估计完整的恢复器训练不确定性。识别改善说明恢复信号对这些分类器更有用，并不等于测量到唯一恢复的发射机硬件特性。若要主张恢复算法本身优于其他方法，仍需匹配的外部恢复对照。

blocks.en: Why the Branches Must Be Evaluated at Two Training Levels
blocks.zh: 为何需要两层分支评价

blocks.en: The joint-holdout deletions in Fig.~\ref{fig:8}, together with the accompanying cross-receiver estimates, provide the strongest consistent branch evidence for nonlinear-memory processing. Removing PA reduces direct cross-receiver six-scene accuracy by 7.21 points under CE and 6.78 under complete SSL. The repeated loss under different objectives supports keeping this branch in a compact model: its contribution is not confined to one unlabeled-learning recipe. This is evidence for the implemented nonlinear-memory representation, rather than direct identification of physical amplifier parameters.
blocks.zh: Fig.~\ref{fig:8} 的双留出删除结果及随附的跨接收机估计，为非线性记忆处理提供了最一致的分支证据。删除 PA 后，直接跨接收机六景准确率在 CE 与完整 SSL 下分别下降 7.21 和 6.78 个百分点。不同训练目标下重复出现的损失支持在紧凑模型中保留该分支，其贡献并非局限于某一无标签学习配方。这里支持的是已实现的非线性记忆表征，而非直接辨识物理功放参数。

blocks.en: Two-layer structural deletions on the joint receiver/date holdout. Top: CE; bottom: complete SSL. Left: accuracy; right: macro-F1. Open circles denote clean and filled squares the six-scene mean; bars show paired sample SD for three seeds. Cross-receiver estimates are provided in the accompanying data.
blocks.zh: 接收机／日期双留出上的两层结构删除。上为 CE，下为完整 SSL；左为准确率，右为 Macro-F1。空心圆为 clean，实心方形为六景平均，误差棒为三个种子的配对样本标准差。跨接收机估计随数据提供。

blocks.en: SIG-TIME illustrates why a single importance ranking would be misleading. Removing it changes CE joint-holdout six-scene accuracy by +0.85 points but complete-SSL accuracy by -2.10 points. The usefulness of the path descriptor therefore depends on the learned representation and training objective. CE asks what the structure learns from true labels; complete SSL asks whether the same structure remains useful with pseudo-identities and feature perturbations. Reading the panels together supports a representation--training interaction, not a claim that every extra descriptor is beneficial in isolation.
blocks.zh: SIG-TIME 说明了单一重要性排序为何会误导。删除该模块后，CE 双留出六景变化为 +0.85 个百分点，完整 SSL 则为 -2.10 个百分点。因此，路径描述的作用依赖已学习表征与训练目标。CE 层回答结构能从真实标签学到什么；完整 SSL 层回答引入伪身份和特征扰动后，同一结构是否仍有用。联合阅读两层结果支持表征与训练之间存在交互，而非证明每个额外描述单独加入都有利。

blocks.en: Nested no-SIG CE controls and historical mechanism deletions remain useful supplementary checks, but retain their own objectives and ordering. They cannot be relabeled as ablations of current fixed-permutation SSL. The mixed signs of smaller effects also discourage pruning solely from one mean: a deployment simplification should preserve robustness across both holdouts and channel conditions, with its cost reduction measured under a consistent execution boundary.
blocks.zh: 去 SIG 嵌套 CE 控制与历史机制删除仍可作为补充检查，但需要保留各自目标与顺序，不能改名为当前固定排列 SSL 的消融。较小效应的正负混合也说明，不应仅依据某个均值裁剪结构。面向部署的精简需要同时保持两类留出与信道条件下的稳健性，并在一致执行边界下测量成本降低。

blocks.en: Implications for Payload-Oriented Inference
blocks.zh: 面向载荷推理的意义

blocks.en: The deployment advantage established by Table~\ref{tab:eff} is a small parameter footprint together with competitive recognition, rather than compactness alone. PAMF uses 232,993 parameters versus 3,847,430 for ResNet-18-1D, a 93.94% reduction, while the CE comparison favors PAMF on held-out data. Its FP32 weights occupy 0.89 MiB; including DURA gives 499,944 parameters and 1.91 MiB of weights. These configurations reduce model storage and the amount of weight data to distribute, offering a concrete advantage when an RF payload must host inference alongside other processing tasks.
blocks.zh: Table~\ref{tab:eff} 所建立的部署优势，是较小参数规模与有竞争力识别表现同时成立，而非只有模型小。PAMF 使用 232993 个参数，ResNet-18-1D 为 3847430 个，减少 93.94%；与此同时，CE 比较中的留出数据表现更有利于 PAMF。其 FP32 权重占 0.89 MiB，连同 DURA 则为 499944 个参数、1.91 MiB 权重。在 RF 载荷需要同时承担其他处理任务时，这两种配置能够减少模型存储及需要分发的权重数据量，形成明确优势。

blocks.en: The operational choice depends on the channel regime. Direct PAMF minimizes the added front-end workload; PAMF+DURA spends extra processing to recover accuracy in severe impairment. Parameter storage excludes activations, workspaces, and runtime buffers, and the reported convolution/matrix counts do not cover all FFT and path-algebra operations. The current evidence therefore supports a compact payload-inference candidate, while achievable throughput, power, and latency must be measured on the intended hardware. No onboard speedup is inferred from parameter ratios.
blocks.zh: 实际配置选择取决于信道条件。直接 PAMF 减少额外前端处理，PAMF+DURA 则通过增加处理改善严重损伤下的准确率。参数存储不包含激活、工作区和运行缓冲，已有卷积／矩阵计数也未覆盖全部 FFT 与路径代数运算。因此，当前证据支持一种紧凑的载荷推理候选设计；可达吞吐量、功耗和时延仍需在目标硬件上测量，不能从参数比例推出星上加速比。

blocks.en: Scope of the Generalization Claim
blocks.zh: 泛化结论的适用范围

blocks.en: The study establishes cross-receiver and receiver/date transfer on measured WiSig IQ under six controlled synthetic channel conditions. These tests share one measurement family and do not establish end-to-end satellite detection, acquisition, or independent in-orbit performance. Three-seed differences are descriptive; small improvements are not labeled statistically significant.
blocks.zh: 本研究在实测 WiSig IQ 与六种受控合成信道条件下，建立跨接收机及接收机／日期迁移证据。这些测试属于同一实测数据家族，尚未建立端到端卫星检测、捕获或独立在轨性能。三种子差异属于描述性结果，较小改善不被表述为统计显著。

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented PAMF for spaceborne passive RF fingerprint identification, addressing receiver generalization and simulated space--ground impairment with a compact model. The source-only identifier retains an advantage over four evaluated external methods under receiver and joint receiver/date holdouts, with only 232,993 parameters and 0.89 MiB of FP32 weights. CE controls associate the compact architecture with competitive discrimination, while two-layer ablations identify a consistent contribution from nonlinear-memory processing and training-dependent effects for SIG-TIME. Ordinary PL remains a strong baseline, so the full SSL recipe is not presented as uniformly superior. Optional independently trained DURA improves the most impaired observations and provides a second accuracy--processing trade-off. The results support payload-oriented inference design on terrestrial measurements with synthetic propagation; independent hardware data and target-platform measurements are needed to establish broader generalization and operational deployment performance.
blocks.zh: 本文面向天基被动射频指纹识别提出 PAMF，以紧凑模型处理跨接收机泛化及模拟星地信道损伤。仅源域训练的识别器在接收机与接收机／日期双留出上保持相对四种已评估外部方法的优势，且仅包含 232993 个参数、0.89 MiB FP32 权重。CE 控制将紧凑架构与有竞争力的判别表现联系起来；两层消融发现非线性记忆处理具有一致贡献，而 SIG-TIME 的作用依赖训练条件。普通 PL 仍是较强基线，完整 SSL 不被表述为普遍占优。独立训练的可选 DURA 改善最严重损伤下的观测，提供另一种准确率与处理开销折中。实测地面数据与合成传播结果支持面向载荷推理的设计；更广泛泛化及实际部署性能仍需独立硬件数据与目标平台测量建立。
